Chart/Sparkline
Micro chart for KPI cards, table cells and list rows. No axes; colour carries direction. 4 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
When to use
Next to a number to show its recent trend.

Bars: discrete periods (daily counts).

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
No axes, no grid, no labels — the number next to it carries the value.
Same time window for every sparkline in a table.
